notes.title: Update 1.8.1.0
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello hunters!!![/b][/p][p]As always, things didn’t go exactly as planned... BUT (and it’s a big “but”) — we’re not leaving you without content, that’s for sure![/p][p]So, what’s going on?[/p][p]Let’s start with the technical side:[/p][p][/p][h2]Networking code and everything related to it.[/h2][p][/p][p][b]A Networking Revolution (with a hint of pain)[/b][/p][p]We had to completely rewrite the game's networking code. Yes, it was tough — feel free to send your sympathies to our programmer.[/p][p]But it was worth it: we've moved from Photon to Mirror, now using Steam P2P.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Instant Connection via Steam Invite[/b][/p][p]The first — and probably most delightful — new feature for you is instant connection to friends through Steam.[/p][p]No more copying lobby codes or waiting for your friend to figure out where to paste them.[/p][p]Just click “Invite Friend” — and they’re in your lobby![/p][p][/p][p]But if someone’s not on your friends list — no worries![/p][p]The lobby code system is still here. Just share the code and jump into the game — no need to add each other as friends.[/p][p]Simple and convenient.[/p][p][/p][p]Another big advantage — Steam now automatically picks the best connection route between players.[/p][p]No more manual server selection — it’s all handled for you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Network Traffic Optimization[/b][/p][p]During the code rewrite, we got rid of excessive network calls that used to overload the connection, and completely reworked the object synchronization system — it’s now smoother and more stable.[/p][p][/p][p]We also improved physical synchronization — for example, tools and items now fall more realistically on the client side, with no more teleporting or jittering.[/p][p]Network load has been significantly reduced in scenes with lots of objects.[/p][p][/p][p]All these improvements have significantly increased the stability and responsiveness of the game’s networking.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Perks[/b][/h2][p]The moment has finally come — you can now customize your character not just visually.[/p][p][/p][p]The perk system introduced in this update will help you deal even more effectively with the threat looming over the world.[/p][p]And what exactly is that threat?[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll only show you the classes here — what they do, you’ll have to find out for yourself.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Legendary Hunter[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/Legend.png"][/img][/p][p][i]You are a legend among all things supernatural.Your skills are nothing short of enviable.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ranger[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/Pathfinder.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Not even the smallest objects can escape your gaze, and your footsteps are silent — even to a directional microphone.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Engineer[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/Tech.png"][/img] [/p][p][i]You’ve dedicated your life to studying electronics — and it has paid off. You also excel at avoiding danger with ease.[/i]                    [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Carrier[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/Porter.png"][/img]                                      [/p][p][i]A pocket, another pocket... You always know exactly where to put everything. And your frugality is something your teammates truly admire.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Do not touch the exhibits... at least not while you're alive.[/h2][p][/p][p]The “Museum” location has been with us for quite some time, witnessing many events — including the Halloween 2023 event. Now, it has undergone a full rework and looks completely refreshed.[/p][p]Familiar features are still recognizable, but now they’re more detailed and atmospheric… or at least we think so.[/p][p]Once home to a popular exhibition that drew crowds of visitors, things are very different now:
Dust has replaced the people, the howling wind has replaced the bustling crowd, and something sinister has taken the place of security — something that won’t let you freely wander its domain. time, witnessing many events — including the Halloween 2023 event. Now, it has undergone a full rework[/p][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/museum_1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/museum_2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/museum_3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/museum_4.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome... back.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Soul Veneration[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve made the bonus content a bit more challenging and added a new twist — now you’ll need to pay your respects to a good portion of a soul.
No more running around the house hoping to stumble upon a signal — now it’s always visible. And not just one![/p][p]Here’s a step-by-step guide:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Find the Signal![/b][/h3][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/FoundSingnal.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Win the Mini-Game[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://ghost-exile.site/img/PlaySingnal.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]All that’s left is to repeat the previous steps a few more times — and the long-awaited room will open before you, where you can finally perform the ritual to honor the part of the soul.[/p][p][/p][h2]New ghost[/h2][p][/p][p][b]"And this… is Viy.."[/b] [/p][p]According to the gathered data, this entity is shrouded in a terrifying, almost tangible darkness. Its presence immediately alters the environment: crystalline structures blacken, as if poisoned by its very aura.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Level 1[/b] – [spoiler]When interacting with salt, causes it to darken, though no visible traces are left behind.[/spoiler][/p][p][/p][p][b]Level 3[/b] – [spoiler]On laser projection, shows no signs of movement — he simply stands motionless for a period of time, then vanishes.[/spoiler][/p][p][/p][p][i]But the most terrifying part — he can distort gravity.[/i][/p][p][i]Everything around him sinks into a thick, oppressive mire: air, objects, even thoughts grow heavy.[/i][/p][p][i]He can increase pressure to unbearable levels.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Level 5[/b] – [spoiler]At the start of a hunt, he can affect the victim in such a way that they temporarily lose the ability to stand, forced to crawl for a limited time.[/spoiler][/p][p] [/p][p][i]- When he materialized, I felt a crushing weight — like I was wearing two hundred bulletproof vests. One more second, and my lungs would've burst.[/i][/p][p][i]I never want to face him again. Ever.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Additional Changes:[/b][/h3][p]One of the previous issues was the save system being located in the game’s installation folder. In some cases, this caused errors due to the application lacking access to that directory. Additionally, there were complications with multi-user saves: when multiple users shared the same computer, their progress could be overwritten, leading to inconvenience.[/p][p]In the latest version, we’ve addressed these problems: the save system has been moved to a system directory, and full multi-account support has been implemented. problems.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.8.0.0 Part 1
notes.content:
[b]Welcome, Hunters![/b]
We’re excited to share some news — the new update is now available! But before we dive into the details, let’s talk a bit about our plans.

At first, we planned to release this update in summer only, since we were working on many changes. But after some discussion, we decided to split the content into several parts. This way, you won’t have to wait too long, and we can fix unstable mechanics faster.

In the end, we decided to release the update in three parts. Each will include new content, mechanics, and technical improvements.

[i]The current version is an [b]experimental build[/b] and will be adjusted in the future.
If you notice anything strange — don’t hesitate to contact us. Also, we ask for your patience: updating the engine and rendering system is a long and careful process. Thank you![/i]

Content:

[h2]New Pipeline — New Possibilities![/h2]

We’ve updated the rendering pipeline and engine version. We know it might not mean much to you, since you probably won’t feel the difference directly. But it gives us more options for effects and optimization.
Yes, most of the work was focused on the engine switch, and while some things are still in progress, we didn’t leave you without content!

[i]If you find any issues or visual bugs, feel free to join our Discord and let us know (link is on the Steam game page).[/i]

[h2]A New Danger![/h2]

[i]Just so you know — don’t say his name. Seriously, don’t…[/i]

Palevoice is a new enemy standing in your way to cleanse the world. He doesn’t like being called by name. Saying it carelessly might bring consequences.

Abilities::

[b]Level 1[/b]
[spoiler]You may hear a loud scream on the recorder[/spoiler]

[b]Level 3[/b]
[spoiler]If you say his name in his favorite room, he might appear or start hunting[/spoiler]

[b]Level 5[/b]
[spoiler]During a hunt, he can mess with your controls[/spoiler]

[h2]Character System[/h2]

A big feature in this update is the avatar system. Now, to start playing, you’ll need to choose an avatar (don’t worry — your current character and progress are safe). You’ll do this in a special editor that opens when you try to create a lobby (only once).

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/V/char1.png[/img]

Each avatar is a separate character with their own progress, money, and experience. You can switch between them anytime. You can also dress each one however you like.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/V/char2.png[/img]

[h2]Rituals[/h2]

New rituals have been added to strengthen your powers and expand the influence of the hunters. Alongside the existing ones, we’ve added:

[list]

You need to close the box — but only when the ghost is standing still.
Touch the ghost = death.
Don’t close the box = also death.

notes.title: New Year's Eve Commotion 1.7.0.0
notes.content:
Hello, hunters! We would like to congratulate you on the upcoming holidays, and for some on the holidays that have already come.  

Thank you for staying with us for so long! 

Thank you for believing in us!

Thank you for appreciating our work, as well as helping to improve and develop the game!

Despite the fact that this year was difficult, we tried to bring a lot of innovations to the game, get rid of a lot of mistakes and improve various aspects of the gameplay. 

If you imagine that the new year is a blank sheet of paper, then we wish you to fill this sheet with only bright, happy and kind stories! And we, in turn, will try to make sure that one of your vivid stories is about Ghost Exile!  

Let's finish with the lyrics and start talking about the update.:

[h2]Trials of the Five Keys[/h2]

The first trial:

Help Billy the snowman find his younger brothers.  

Billy's brothers have scattered all over the village, but Billy is the main snowman and cannot leave his post. Help Billy find his lost brothers. [I]Wait, why are they yellow...[/i]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/snowman.png[/img]

The second trial:

Return the gifts!

Evil ghostly souls stole gifts from the villagers and took them to their places of residence. Take the order, get rid of the ghost and collect the gifts.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/gifts.png[/img]

The third trial: 

Hit the target!

The owner of the shooting range has pocketed the key, he will give it back only on condition that you win three times in his shooting range.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/tir.gif[/img]

The fourth trial:

Ледовая трасса!

One of the keys is located in a rather dangerous place - the ice track. Complete the ice track and return the key! 

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/parkur.gif[/img]
[i]Why does the long button work?..[/i]

The fifth trial:

Express delivery!

Santa crashed in the village and cannot deliver gifts, but the villagers have a gift cannon, and Santa is able to teleport houses to which gifts need to be delivered for a short time. Unfortunately, magic is unstable and houses don't stand still, so you'll have to work hard to get into the chimney!

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/cannon.gif[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/CAM_MOD.gif[/img]

A module that provides you with a set of different fuses for all occasions. With this module, you don't have to look for fuses all over the house. However, the price is quite high due to the number of fuses for different models of electrical panels.


Consumables such as pills, incense, crosses, and more are now consumed. What you've drunk, eaten, burned won't come back to you, you'll have to get a new one.
(Namely Crucifixion, Incense, Sedative, Urn with Incense)

[h2]Ghost Events[/h2]

The ghost event system, or simply the screamers, has undergone changes. Some of the old screamers have been redesigned or updated, and a number of new events have been added that you should find out about yourself. This is just the beginning of work on the ghost event system, so there's more to come in the future...

Hello hunters! We have another update for you. This time, we have worked on some aspects of the game, such as the ghosts' favorite items, equipment, and evidence.

[h2]Radio(Not only the new model)[/h2]

The radio receiver has been modified both externally and internally to give the ghost at least some chance to preserve this evidence, at least for a while.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/SB_NEW.jpg[/img]
Now you can get an answer from the ghost [b] only in the dark[/b], and also the hunter will have to [b] look for the right frequency[/b] of the radio receiver to get an answer.

[h2]Ghost's new and favorite things[/h2]

The text of the notes has been redesigned, as well as the appearance of some items. Now your favorite things can be divided into the following categories:

[list]
[*] Toys
[*] Jewelry
[*] Talismans
[*] Memorabilia
[/list]

Now hunters [b] will not be able to capture photo[/b] ghost favorite object outside the house, and now this can lead to serious consequences, up to [b]the start of the hunt[/b]!

[h2]Your assistant in the investigation[/h2]

Many people have difficulties finding certain evidence, such as laser projections, traces of ectoplasm, ectoplasm, and motion sensors. Therefore, we have decided to introduce a system that can help you find evidence. The system will increase the chances of finding the necessary evidence based on the amount of evidence that is already available.

If you have one piece of evidence, the system will increase your chances of finding the other two. If you have two pieces of evidence, your chances of finding the last piece will be even better.

[h3]What else?[/h3]

The scan radius of the PEK has been increased, and the signal with the highest value will now always be in the ghost's favorite room.

The tent model has been updated - the quality has been improved and details have been added.

- Fixed an error when the volumetric lighting setting was reset at the beginning of the order

- Attenuated the noise of the player's built-in flashlight when volumetric lighting is turned on

- Fixed a bug when the task "Do not use running in the world of shadows" did not count

notes.title: Update 1.6.0.0
notes.content:
[i]From various parts of the country, reports have been received from commanders of hunting units regarding the emergence of an unknown entity. Many hunters have been killed or gone missing. Those who have returned report that the entity is able to perform various deceptive actions, and its behaviour during materialization is different from what has been seen before. The General Staff has also reported that most ghosts and demons that we have previously exorcised have gained new abilities. Therefore, all units are required to be notified and instructed in accordance with the information received. Is this related to the emergence of this new entity?[/i]

[h2]Meet [b]Ronove[/b][/h2]

The new type of Ronove ghost is capable of various tricks from simple deceptive proof and substitution of your records to a special kind of hunting.

Description of abilities by level:

At level 1: Able to create two ghostly lights.(NOT A PROOF!)
At level 3: It is able to replace the evidence you have recorded with others.
At level 5: Able to perform a unique type of hunting.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/ronove_double.gif[/img]
[i]"Double ghostly light"[/i]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/ronove_fool.gif[/img]
[i]"Ronove changes the evidence"[/i]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/ronove_hunt.gif[/img]
[i]"Special hunting"[/i]

With his appearance, Ronove also strengthened other entities...

[h2]Types of hunts[/h2]

We decided to add variety to the hunting mechanics, namely, a new item "dangerous ghost" has been added to the list of additional content, which brings several new types of hunts to the game.

"The mark of Belphegor" - This type of hunting is considered one of the most dangerous. The ghost always feels your presence and is rapidly moving towards you, developing an incredible speed that I have not seen yet. However, once near the hunter, he begins to weaken, and his speed decreases significantly.

[b]A sign of hunting is a loud rumble.[/b]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/hunt_slow.gif[/img]

"The Curse of Sanpaku" - During this type of hunting, it is impossible to hide from a ghost and it moves quite fast. The hunter's gaze keeps him in place, but the longer you look at him, the more he will avert your gaze. During this hunt, it is recommended to avoid confined spaces and keep the ghost in sight.

[b]A sign of the beginning of such a hunt is the grinding of metal.[/b]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/hunt_see.gif[/img]

"The Devil's Box" - The hunt is accompanied by a variety of music boxes throughout the house. Hunters need to focus on the sound of music and close the playing boxes. The hunt will end as soon as you close enough boxes, otherwise one of you will die...

[b]A sign of the beginning of such a hunt is a lot of music boxes.[/b]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/hunt_music.gif[/img]

"The crying of Gaap" - The crying entity is somewhere in the house, find it and say "Go away." Focus on the sound of crying, but remember that a ghost can deceive you. If you do not find the one who is crying in time and do not chase him away in time, one of you will die. 

[b]A sign of the beginning of such a hunt is the crying of a child.[/b]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/hunt_plach.gif[/img]

"Demon of darkness" - is a type of hunting during which you will not see the material manifestation of a ghost, darkness will envelop you and the only salvation is a weak piece of light that moves around the house. Stay inside it until the hunt is over. If you were outside the world at the time of the end of the hunt, you will die.

[b]A sign of the beginning of such a hunt is the impenetrable darkness.[/b]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/hunt_light.gif[/img]

[i][b]Remember that a ghost can start any type of hunt at the time of the order. Check out the detailed information about the types of hunts in the new section of the journal before including this additional content.[/b][/i]

[h2]"New" old maps[/h2]

A couple of maps and the initial lobby have been redesigned.

[h3]House on Central street[/h3]

[i]There are many rumors associated with this house, from the banal witch to the abode of ghosts, but the reality is much scarier... Once upon a time there lived a married couple with a son whom no one had ever seen. According to police reports from those years, a cage was found in the house where Henry was being held. His parents said it was for his own good and that his unbridled appetite could make him do terrible things. The remains of human bodies were also found in the house... This house attracts various evil entities, and the aura that hovers there feeds them.[/i]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/central (1).png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/central (2).png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/central (3).png[/img]


[h3]House on 9 street[/h3]

[i]In appearance, an ordinary house even before the disaster had oddities - sounds outside the walls, missing things and other manifestations of an otherworldly presence. We do not even doubt that these features attract entities, because this is one of the first houses in which portals began to open.[/i]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/9st (1).png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/9st (2).png[/img]

[i]It has become too dangerous to stay close to the city, so we have changed the location of your stay - this is an old motel on the highway that leads to the city
[/i]

[h3]Lobby Motel[/h3]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/motel (1).jpg[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/motel (2).jpg[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/motel (3).jpg[/img]


[h2]Major changes[/h2]

[h3]Ouija Board[/h3]

As we reported earlier, the Ouija board has also been redesigned. There are a number of new questions and even requirements. Now the candle has additional functionality that visually shows how angry the ghost is with your questions.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/News/New%20ouija.gif[/img]

Now the current map will be displayed on the screen of your directional microphone, so that it is easier for you to navigate the area and better understand where the sound is located.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/direct_mic.gif[/img]

[h3]The new ghost model[/h3]

The model of an elderly woman has been added.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/G/old_woman.png[/img]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] There are now two non-numbered characters on the "Insane" difficulty in the shadow world.

[*] On the "Insane" difficulty, the shadow world can appear only once.

[*] The "Big Hotel" map has a balanced gameplay - the various manifestations of the ghost that can appear in rooms are now centered around the room where the seal of exile is located. In the world of shadows, a light will fly out of the lamp with a small frequency that moves in the direction of the hint.

[*] Now 3 sources of "PEK" are created at once and 3 levels at once if the ghost has this proof.

[*] The mini-game "Keep Calm in the Closet" is now FPS-independent.

[*] The rendering scale has been increased to 100%.

[*] Fixed a bug where hints in the shadow world could appear on the ceiling.

[*] Added a setting to disable the display of the ghost's name in the book of rituals if one of the hunters has a passport in his inventory.

[*] Added automatic exclude of impossible evidence if at least 2 pieces of evidence are marked.

[*] Now the ghostly light can only appear in the ghost's favorite room or the rooms closest to it.

notes.title: It's becoming more dangerous
notes.content:
Greetings, hunters! The next update is already close and again we have prepared many changes for you. Here is a short description of what awaits you:

[b][i]He doesn't care about the battle between humans and small demons, but boredom will force him to come into our world, and survivors will doubt whether this battle can be won. Something terrible is coming, and it will relentlessly and unrestrainedly punish anyone it encounters on its path. But not for the sake of victory, but only to satisfy his pride.[/i][/b]

A new type of ghost is on the way and this will be the first ghost that we will add since the release of "Ghost Exile". Hopefully not the last one...

You will also find a new ghost model for an elderly woman.

[h3]The connecting link...[/h3]

[b][i] — What should I say? This is the first time I'm going to communicate with the soul of a deceased person, and are you sure it's not dangerous?
— Of course not, listen, Dylan and I have already done this a hundred times, although no one has answered us.
— Okay, so what do I... listen, does a candle have to burn so much?
— No, did you hear that...?
[/i][/b]

The Ouija board has also undergone changes. From a completely new look to functionality. Now, for the rite of spiritualism, it is advisable for you to have a candle next to the board, but this is not just a farce, the wax assistant will tell you how angry your questions are.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/News/New ouija.gif[/img]

A number of new questions have also been added. And the reactions to standard questions have been changed.

[h3]Restyling[/h3]

Also, there is a change in the visual style of older houses. There are some small changes to the layout, but they will still remind you of familiar places.

Here are screenshots of one of them, namely "9 street".

We will not disclose the details yet, you will see everything when the time comes. And we hope that we will not be late this year...

notes.title: Optimization and HDR (Beta)
notes.content:
[h2]Hello hunters![/h2]

Today we are pleased to introduce a [u][b]test update[/b][/u], in which we have made improvements to the following areas: rendering time, network load, and the core gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41456438/152073c4aee6a26b8d788f1819e1bee69e85049a.jpg[/img]
We have significantly reduced the resource usage of the central processing unit (CPU) and graphics processing unit (GPU) in this update. If you have had difficulties with the performance of the game before, it is recommended to try this version and compare the load indicators before and after.

We have reduced the number of network interactions between players, which has decreased the load on the network and may have solved some of the problems that were previously encountered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41456438/10435d305813d4d46ced1251cc4f74807500847c.jpg[/img]
Now, HDR support is functioning correctly, and players will be able to experience the game in this mode.

[b][h2]How do I download the test version?[/h2][/b]
[i]Since the update is experimental, you can download it only on a separate beta version on Steam. To do this, select the game in the list, right-click and select "Properties". [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41456438/fd157639b1caab47b4a2fde6b629f530419c87cc.png[/img]

[i]Then, go to the "Beta version" tab and select "beta_optimization_hdr support" from the dropdown list. After that, download the update and enjoy the new version of the game.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41456438/bdc908cab8c262759cb25b3ad019178520dbae8e.png[/img]

Thank you for your interest in our game! We are excited to announce that the next update will bring many exciting gameplay improvements and refinements to the current content. We hope to see you in the game soon!

Good hunting!

notes.title: Update 1.4.2.0
notes.content:
Hello hunters! And we come to you with a new update. So let's get right to the point.


[h2]New evidence and tool[/h2]

A new "PEK" tool has been added to the game. The principle of its operation is very simple, the ghost forms an energy field ([b] often in a favorite room[/b]) that moves chaotically at a low speed. When the instrument captures the signal, a message will appear on the screen and the "wings" of the instrument will begin to rise indicating the direction of the signal. When you are in close proximity to the signal source, a "good signal" will appear on the screen. And then you just have to wait!

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/PEK.gif[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/PEK2.gif[/img]

The new device also brought with it new evidence, do you remember the ghosts of which could be identified by just two pieces of evidence? Now their third proof is the "PEK" signal. 

[b]You can also use the device to help you find the location of hints in the world of shadows. When your friend is exploring the world of shadows, you can use the "PEK" in your hand to search for clues and find their location in our world.[/b]

[h2]New map view and detailed information[/h2]

The monitor with the map has gone through significant changes. First, it was moved to a task monitor in order to save space and improve convenience.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Map1.png[/img]

The appearance of the maps has also been improved. Now, interior items are displayed, such as cabinets, tables, and more. Additionally, the names of the rooms have been correctly positioned.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Map22.gif[/img]

Another innovation is the more accurate positioning of players and sensors on a map. Speaking of sensors, they have been improved by the military and now much more information comes from them. For example, a motion sensor now displays, on the map screen, the time it was last activated and the signal received (green or orange).

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Map3.png[/img]

And sound sensors now not only display the location of the sound source on the map, but also show the volume level, thereby making it clear which sounds are worth paying attention to and which can be ignored. [b]Another way to find the actual location of a ghost![/b]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Map4.png[/img]

[h2]New maps![/h2]

Once upon a time, this abandoned warehouse had a terrible reputation. In addition to regular drug addicts and homeless people, who often choose this place as a refuge, there have been many terrible murders. Also, local bandits often choose this place to torture their victims. Now, it is a place of power for ghosts and other supernatural entities.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Warehouse1.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Warehouse2.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Warehouse3.png[/img]

Although this hotel is not the most popular in the city, it has always had guests. Some of them have literally lived there permanently. Its cheap price and the quietness of the nearby streets have covered up all the disadvantages, and even the fact that its neighbors may not be the nicest people - psychopaths and rapists - did not bother them. It is said that a famous writer committed suicide in one of the rooms of this hotel, after going insane from the atmosphere of this place. Think what you will, but this is a truly dangerous place at the moment...

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Hotel1.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Hotel2.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Hotel3.png[/img]

[h2]New clothes[/h2]

There are several things in the wardrobe that will not only give you personality, but will make it clear to others that you are a seasoned hunter. The fabric of these things was soaked with energy, which breaks out of the seal after the completion of the ritual, which is why some parts of these things begin to glow brightly when interacting with the seal or when you are in the world of shadows! 

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Outfit.gif[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/10.03.24/Outfit2.gif[/img]

You can buy these things for the cursed coins that are given out every day or given for exorcising ghosts.


[h2]Custom ritual lines[/h2]

[spoiler]The texts of the rituals are now placed in a separate folder of the game for the convenience of those who want to help with the translation or for those who want to write their own ritual and offer it as an alternative.  

File location: [b]"GhostExile\GhostExile_Data\StreamingAssets\Rituals\"[/b]

[b]REMEMBER! The number of lines in the ritual should always be equal to the original ritual, no more, no less.[/b][/spoiler]

[h2]Minor changes and fixes[/h2]

The interior of the tent has been slightly rearranged for more convenient interaction with the screens.

The French language file has been updated

The Italian language file has been updated

Fixed a bug where the behavior of level 5 ghosts could be that of level 3 and 4 ghosts.

notes.title: New Year's Update 1.4.0.0
notes.content:
Hello hunters, and here is the New Year's fair! Entertainment and gifts will be waiting for you at every corner...

We thought, but Krampus is again trying to spoil the holiday by stealing gifts from obedient hunters. And the lights on the Christmas tree are not lit at all... Well, it looks like you're going to have to save the New Year's holiday again!

To re-light the lights on the Christmas tree, you need to collect 100 ghost tickets. To do this, do what you know best - EXILE GHOSTS! Or try to take away stolen gifts from Krampus, but be vigilant Krampus dark abode is his old dark mansion.

The mansion is a dangerous place where Krampus lives, find the gifts and take them out of the house. If the inhabitant of the mansion grabs you, he will throw you into his cage from which you cannot get out without help. [spoiler]If you are alone, an elf assistant will help you once. If you are in a team, only a friend can save you.[/spoiler]

For defeating the Campus, you will receive cursed coins that can be spent on participating in the New Year's fair. Diffcult (1,2,4,5) coins.


[i]Krampus is dirty and does not like to clean up very much, look carefully at your feet![/i]

[i][b]Save the holiday and win prizes along the way![/b][/i]

[h2]New[/h2]

[i] It seems that Krampus' arrival in our world has strengthened the forces of evil and the ghosts have gained new abilities[/i]
The third level of the ghosts' unique abilities is now available. Here is their description:

[b] Attention spoilers![/b]

[b]Amanojaku [/b]
From time to time, the hunters' minds may be distracted

[b]Kineg [/b]
Can whisper a curse on the hunter (the hunter needs to leave the house immediately to remove the curse)

[b]Dybbuk [/b]
The Dybbuk is able to stage a hunt by tricking the players. If all the players are in the closet during the deceptive hunt, he will close all the doors in the house and open all the cabinets

[b]The Genie [/b]
During the hunt, he can make an electro-jump to move

[b]Doppler[/b]
At the beginning of the hunt, he can create his own full-fledged copy that can kill players

[b]Kidjo[/b]
If you take a picture of him while hunting, he can interrupt the attack

[b]Mara [/b]
It imposes an impenetrable fog during hunting

[b]Mogwai[/b]
May cause a malfunction of the temperature measuring equipment

[b]Mononoke[/b]
During the hunt, he opens all the doors with special force and can also hit the closet, thereby opening its doors and throwing the hunter out

[b]Mulling[/b]
During hunting, it can stun hunters

[b]Obake [/b]
If there is an active Baphomet seal in the house, then Obake will scare the players next to her much more often. And during the hunt, he can teleport into the room with the seal of Baphomet

[b]They[/b]
Hypersensitivity to the hunter's steps

[b]Onre[/b]
It is capable of disabling the walkie-talkie for a while or drowning out the voice

[b]Feast[/b]
If you hide in the closet during the hunt, which is located in the ghost's favorite room, the hunt will not end until you come out

[b]Pishachi [/b]
Can start a false hunt if a false ghost reaches the hunter then his mind will become zero

[b]Poltergeist[/b]
During the hunt, he can throw an object at the player to slow him down

[b]Reiki[/b]
Sometimes he can hide tools from hunters

[b]The Revenant[/b]
If there are no whole crucifixes in the house, its speed will be twice as high

[b]Shinigami[/b]
During the hunt, it will be impossible to hide from him in the closet

[b]Wider[/b]
During the hunt, he can choose to target one player by sending the rest outside the house. If the player is alone, then during the hunt he can stage the end of the hunt, but it will continue

Added a new voice chat effect via radio.

[h1]Happy holidays dear friends![/h1]

On behalf of our team, we would like to congratulate you on the upcoming new year and Christmas and wish that next year was definitely better than the previous one and that it was full of positive emotions let all your ideas and dreams come true!

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0.0
notes.content:
Welcome hunters! The third part of the "Terrifying" update is finally out. Force majeure circumstances did not allow us to make it in time, for which we ask you to forgive us.

Okay, enough of the bad stuff, let's talk about the update!

In this part, we focused on adding mechanics that will be developed in the future, as well as on fixing and reworking some old things.

[h1]Let's start with the innovations:[/h1]


[h2]Mysterious Artifact[/h2]

Experienced hunters report that the energy of the seal changes when exiled, it is able to form strange objects. The nature of these things has not yet been studied, but it is known that "artifacts" are able to influence the owner and give some supernatural abilities.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/art1.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/art2.png[/img]

[i]Be aware strange objects can have side effects. You have to pay for everything...[/i]

Here is a description of some of them:

[expand type=details]

The Gift of Ra
When using an artifact endowed with this gift, the sanity of all hunters nearby will be restored. After use, the artifact is destroyed.

Mitre's look
When using the artifact, it can show you the ghost's favorite room. After prolonged use, the artifact is destroyed.

Blessing of Ra
The artifact has a passive ability to restore sanity if it is in the hands. After prolonged use, the artifact is destroyed.

Contract of Nefertem
The artifact will provide the hunter with light around him, protecting his mind. After prolonged use, the artifact is destroyed.

Contract of Dedven
When using the artifact, it serves as an incense with a longer action and reusable use. After being used 3 times, the artifact is destroyed.

[/expand]

[h2]Interface update[/h2]

The interface of the main and in-game menus has been completely redesigned. The old interface was too overloaded and sometimes caused slight sagging, so it was decided to completely replace it with a new one.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/menu1.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/menu2.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/menu3.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/menu4.png[/img]

[h2]Single player[/h2]

As you may have noticed, the "Single Player" button has appeared in the menu. That's right, a single mode has been added to the game for those who may want to play without having access to the Internet.

[h2]New map[/h2]

Old Turnersoll mansion an old mansion that kept a lot of terrible secrets even before the apocalypse.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/map1.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/map2.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/map3.png[/img]


[h2]Disabling map detail[/h2]

Now in the settings you can disable some small interior objects, thereby slightly reducing the load for weak computers or in order to facilitate the search for really important items on the map.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/Deco_off.gif[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/Deco_off1.gif[/img]

[h2]New lobby with the possibility of decorative changes[/h2]

The bunker is finally available! With the money earned on orders, you can buy a bunker and make it your new main lobby.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/bunk1.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/bunk2.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/bunk3.png[/img]

Also added the ability to customize some rooms of the bunker. In future updates, the list of decorative and functional objects will be updated.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/bunk_edit.gif[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/bunk_edit1.png[/img]

[h2]The tent is back[/h2]

The bulky container has removed! The military tent is back like in the good old days.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/tent1.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/tent2.png[/img]

[h2]Share the ultraviolet[/h2]

The long-standing problem with the UV flashlight is now in the past. Now the prints are visible in multiplayer mode, for example, if your friend shines on the door, you will also see the prints. The system of the appearance of prints has also been redesigned and situations when prints did not always appear are excluded.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/UV.png[/img]

[h2]Text guides[/h2]

Several articles about the gameplay have been added to the training center. If you still have questions about some mechanics, contact the monitor in the lobby.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/guide.png[/img]

[h2]New ghost model[/h2]

The model of an adult woman has been changed

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/woman.png[/img]

[h2]Small changes[/h2]


[b]A check mark has been added to the settings that allows you to open all types of ghosts.[/b]

================================================================================

We know that you are sick of having the same ghost drop out several orders in a row. This is in the past, the new system will pick up a new ghost for you every order.

================================================================================

The "weak bloom" item appeared in the settings. If some lamps seem too bright to you, turn it on.

================================================================================

The "volumetric sound" item has been added to the settings. If you are experiencing problems with sound, for example, cod, you can turn off surround sound.

================================================================================

There is a choice of lighting quality in the settings. If you experience performance problems when you turn on the light, reduce the quality of lighting. This can greatly affect the visual component of lighting, but it will give you a good performance boost.

================================================================================

Added a third type of rover behavior - an assistant in exile. It's capable of lighting candles and closing portals, but that doesn't mean you don't have to do anything, the rover is pretty slow!

================================================================================

The exile effect has been augmented.

================================================================================

The price of the rover has risen from 250 to 2250

================================================================================

The complexity of the madman has undergone changes and has been balanced.

================================================================================

The objects that the ghost threw may now also show traces of ectoplasm.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Fixed bugs with ghost events when they could hang until the end of the match;

    [*]Fixed bugs with the second level of ghost abilities;

    [*]Fixed a bug where the Ouija board didn't name the room with the documents if they were in the wall behind the painting;

    [*]Fixed a bug where the rover could get stuck on the way to the destination;

    [*]Fixed a bug where the sound of the portal could loop if you break the connection during its closure;

    [*]Fixed a bug where the items of a player who left the match disappeared;

    [*]Fixed a bug where some items could appear behind the house or not appear at all;

    [*]Fixed a bug where the light could blink;

    [*]Fixed a bug where the ghost's favorite room was smaller than the print;

    [*]Fixed a bug when when character textures always remained in low resolution.
[/list]

[h1]Another evening of All Saints[/h1]

A late event is also an event!

Go through a small test in which you have to collect candy in houses with ghosts, but be on your guard the entities will not be thrilled when they see that you are stealing their sweets. Celebrate Halloween once again with our team, collect treats and get unique rewards!

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/terra3/event.png[/img]

[h2]Plans until the end of the year[/h2]

Before the end of the year, another update will be released in which we will add 3 levels of unique ghost abilities and a New Year's fair!

To spark your interest, we will tell you a little about the fair:

This is a unique event of this year in which you will have the opportunity to participate in events and trials at the New Year's fair. Various attractions and entertainment with unique rewards and small prizes. You will be able to win game items, money, costumes, achievements over the past years and more!

[i]Join us at the New Year 2024 Fair![/i]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.0 ( Terrifying - "Part 2" )
notes.content:
Welcome hunters! So the moment has come for the release of the second part of the "Terrifying" update. It was the most voluminous and difficult part of this update cycle. So, let's talk about the update itself in more detail.

[h2]Ghosts[/h2]

[i]Games are over[/i]

Much of the ghost has been reworked and added::

The AI of ghosts during hunting has been completely redesigned, now entities rely more on the sound that you make chasing the sounds of your steps and equipment. Now the ghost will definitely check the place where he last heard the sounds and can even check the cabinets - an updated mini-game during which you need to hold the cursor in a certain area, if you fail the event, then with a high probability the ghost will open the closet.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/Minigame.gif[/img]

[i]The ghosts gain strength and try to get you out as quickly as possible[/i]

[b]14 new ghostly events to keep you even more at bay while hunting on ghost. [/b]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/Scrim_1.png[/img]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/scrim_flying_things.gif[/img]

[h3]Unique abilities and traits[/h3]

[i]The longer they are in our world, the stronger they become[/i]

A new level of abilities of ghosts and demons, after you meet with one type of entity a sufficient number of times, it will become stronger and acquire new features that can both help determine the type faster and cause a lot of problems during the order.

[b]Amanojaku[/b]

New unique trait: sanity meter of the hunters may be displayed incorrectly.

[b]Caoineag[/b]

New unique trait:Caoineag will try to drive the victim insane by implying that it’s nearby.

[b]Dibbuk[/b]

New unique trait:Dibbuk will silently close the door and start the hunt. At first, it won’t make any sounds, the sensors will also be silent

[b]Djinn[/b]

New unique trait:A small chance to turn on all the electric items in the house at once

[b]Doppler[/b]

New unique trait:Creates a trap-room, with its clone standing in it, which also produces sounds. If a hunter enters this room, all  doors close on lock in the house, including closet doors.

[b]Kijo[/b]

New unique trait:If you look at Kijo, your vision will become worse for some time.

[b]Mara[/b]

New unique trait:can temporarily disable your flashlight.

[b]Mogwai[/b]

New unique trait:can drop the temperature in the house extremely low, slowing down the players.

[b]Mononoke[/b]

New unique trait:Can knock things off the walls and other surfaces.

[b]Myling[/b]

New unique trait:can produce a harsh rumble during the hunt, which desorients the hunters and makes them drop the item in their hands.

[b]Obake[/b]

New unique trait:if Obake breaks the Astaroth seal, it will start the hunt and will get a 10-second speed boost.

[b]Oni[/b]

New unique trait:its stomping during the hunt can knock candles and ritual items off the exile seal.

[b]Onryo[/b]

New unique trait:you can see blood drops on the floor.

[b]Piru[/b]

New unique trait:closes the door in its favorite room during the hunt.

[b]Pishachi[/b]

New unique trait:can open false portals. You will only hear a sound, which will disappear when getting closer.

[b]Poltergeist[/b]

New unique trait:during the hunt, can lift objects in the air in a few rooms at once (screamer with physical objects, but in a few different places at once).

[b]Reiki[/b]

New unique trait:the more tools there are in the house, the faster Reiki is during the hunt. (1% speed for every tool, but no more than 20%)

[b]Revenant[/b]

New unique trait:using a crucifix on him will provoke a second hunt during which the Revenant will be speeded up.

[b]Shinigami[/b]

New unique trait:can open all closets at once during the hunt.

[b]Shiryo[/b]

New unique trait:if all hunters will be in close proximity to Shiryo for more than ? seconds, it will turn off the light and appear before every hunter.

[h3]No - constant hunting![/h3]

We noticed that there are times when a ghost storms hunters with constant attacks and does not let them breathe. Now it has been reworked and with each new attack the entity will lose strength and the gap between materializations will increase. The number of attacks and the increase in time depends on the difficulty.

[h3]And also...[/h3]

- A new model of the ghost boy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41456438/c71b30f1eedc987a970c33f628e3bf01162633ce.jpg[/img]

- New sounds of footsteps while hunting.

- The protective seal now stops hunting with one hundred percent probability.

[h2]Equipment[/h2]

[i]We need the best equipment for successful hunting...[/i]

The military leadership has provided you with new and updated equipment for more productive work.

[h3]Rover[/h3]

For solo hunters and not only, an assistant has been added that will not only deliver things to you from a container or collect things scattered around the house, but also protect you during a ghost attack.

In the phone, you can find a tab for controlling the rover (a module is needed) and set it one of the behavior schemes:

[b]Collector[/b]

The "Collector" behavior scheme has three behavior settings:

- Collect all the items in the house and return them to the container

- Collects all items that lie for more than 3 minutes and are not in the same room with the seal of exile

-Collects all the items that fell out of the dead players

[b]Defender[/b]

The "Defender" behavior scheme has three behavior settings:

- Uses incense and a cross when the ghost is near the rover

- Uses incense and a cross when the ghost has noticed the player and is near the rover

- Will look for a ghost after the start of the hunt in order to apply a cross or incense on it

Or give him a specific command or a list of commands that he will execute in turn.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/rover_take_item.gif[/img]
[b]List of commands:[/b]

- Bring the item to the player who gives the command. It is necessary to select an item from the list (the distance from the player to the item is indicated next to the name of the item)

- Bring a thing to a certain room. It is necessary to choose the room to which the rover will deliver the item, and then select the item to be delivered.

- Come to the room. The rover will arrive at the room selected from the list and will wait there for the next team.

- Take the thing. Takes the item selected from the list and puts it in the trunk.

- Quit everything. Throws away all the things that are in the trunk.

[b]Hard reboot[/b]

If the rover has started experiencing problems, try restarting it. [i]The technique is still...[/i]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/rover_run.gif[/img]


[h3]Remake of the phone[/h3]

Redesigned the phone model, as well as its internal functions and UI. Now, in addition to the inventory, the phone has applications:
- Rover control application (module required)

- Application of remote switch-on of the switchboard (module required)

- The "My Tasks" application. Remote viewing of additional tasks, as well as tracking their execution - vibration when performing a task.(module required)

- The application "My indicators". Displays the sanity levels of all hunters in the order, as well as the overall sanity level.(module required)

Now the phone will notify you about the beginning of the hunt and about its end.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/Phone_1.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/Phone_2.png[/img]

[h3]That's not all...[/h3]

- Activity printing now has a new functionality - after printing, it must be activated (interaction key) thereby provoking abnormal activity in the ghost's favorite room. The print has a new effect and sound that will increase over time. REMEMBER! Long-term use of printing is fraught! After a few seconds, the seal will break and cause a hunt, use with caution.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/activ_seal.gif[/img]

[b]You can use it to find the ghost's favorite room or to summon an early hunt.[/b]

- Restyle the recorder and a new UI.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/Dictophone.png[/img]

- Now the standard set of tools has one laser projector and one voice recorder.

- The recorder has been removed from the store since it now comes in a standard set of tools.

- The devices now emit sounds and attract a ghost while hunting.

[h2]Sounds[/h2]

- Added surround sound system. Now the sounds that are behind the wall or far away from the player will be muted, and those that are nearby will be more voluminous.

- New ambient sounds that make orders more atmospheric. A crushing sound in the absence of light, creaks, knocks and other things that keep you in suspense.

- Now, when the light is on, there is no oppressive sound of darkness.

- Devices now also emit sounds that the ghost hears and react to ghostly events.

[h2]Additional content[/h2]

The world of shadows has been completely redesigned. Added a soul lamp that will help you in the world of shadows. With the help of a lamp, you need to hold a light before the ritual seal, and it also has the ability to scare away shadows around you (RMB). But not everything is so simple, the guardian of the world of shadows has locked a piece of a kind soul in a cage and you need to open it to release the light.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/SW_lamp.png[/img]

After opening the portal to the world of shadows, take the lamp from the container, throw away all other objects, then enter the world of shadows. You will need to find the hint symbols that will open the cell. There are three symbols in total and the ordinal number is indicated on them in Roman numerals (except for the complexity "Insane"). Find all three symbols, and then enter the desired sequence on the runestones above the cage. After a short delay, the cage will open and you can use a lamp (LMB) to tighten a piece of the soul to guide it to printing.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Terra_2/SW_simbol.png[/img]

The guardian of the world of shadows will do everything possible to prevent you from releasing a piece of soul. She moves to different rooms, patrols the house and runs to the place where you touched the shadow. Remember, when the lamp is on, the guardian of the shadow world sees you better.

At the "Insane" difficulty level, you may need to spend a piece of the soul several times, there is also no numbering with a symbol and you need to select a combination. If the combination is entered incorrectly, the guardian of shadows will run to the cage - hide!

Hello hunters, we have worked on the minuses of part 1 of the update once again, and decided to make some changes.

[h2]Light Mode[/h2]
The first changes that worried us were the lighting mode in the dark, some players asked us to return the lighting back, of course we won't return anything back, but we tried to make it optional. We have added a new setting (Lighting Mode), it has 3 modes (Darker , Lighter, Vision Problem), each of them changes the lighting in its own way.

Darker ( Brightness - 1.5 )
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/3_d.png[/img]

Lighter ( Brightness - 1.5 )
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/2_d.png[/img]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/1_d.png[/img]

Do not forget that the brightness setting also plays a role, so when choosing the lighting mode, also adjust the brightness to your liking

[h2]Evidence viewer[/h2]
This system caused a lot of complaints, so we worked on it, corrected some inaccuracies because of which sometimes the system did not count the evidence. And also simplified the model of calculating the definition, which will also eliminate failures in it.

[h2]Ghost Research[/h2]
We have been thinking about this problem for a long time and also identified some problems that can cause negativity during the game. We have added 2 new buttons to the book that will slightly smooth out the corners of the dissatisfied.

1 - Share records ( now you can share the open ghosts in your diary with the whole team , so if you played without friends or just want to share your records with someone by clicking on this button , you will send the records to everyone who is with you in the match )

2 - Exclude impossible evidence (By clicking on the (Exclude incorrect evidence) button, the book will tell you what you need to check to get 3 proof, remember that the button is unlocked when you enter 2 correct evidence.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/2_correct_evi.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1.6.0b
notes.content:
Some players didn't quite like our changes to the darkness in the game, we did some work on it and slightly improved the brightness in the game.
However, we do not intend to return the way it was before. But still, we have increased the brightness of the flashlight (T by default), remember, to improve the brightness and range of the flashlight, you need to switch to the module mode in the "Equipment" section to buy a flashlight upgrade and press the toggle switch (Take (with you to order))
We also added a mode for people who can't see well, this mode improves the flashlight to level 2 because after the flashlight it already becomes quite bright. There was also an improvement in the player's vision in the dark so that the environment could be seen 3 meters away.
We hope that we have calmed down the players who did not like the changes in darkness. We apologize for the inconvenience. You may need to adjust the brightness settings slightly to achieve a normal effect.

After examining the ghost on the ghost research desk, the ghost will be automatically selected in your diary.

We also want to explain to you exactly how the study of ghosts works. In fact, everything is simple, you just need to see the evidence, for example, the answer to the radio, or see the light on the camera that flies around the room (it is advisable to consider the light more carefully), see the drawings in a notebook, etc.
And only after that you have to go up to the second floor of the container and enter the evidence in a special book (you need exactly 3 evidence remember that Pishachi can give false evidence, so its definition may be a little more difficult.
After that, you will successfully add a new ghost to your diary. If for some reason you have difficulties with this system and you are sure (100%) that you did everything right, contact us.
The surest solution would be to record the part of the gameplay where you see the evidence, and you entered them in the search book and the system does not give you anything.
Then we will be able to make sure that an error has occurred and we should check everything again.

[i]Thank you for your attention, be patient and kinder, there is no need to show negativity just because you don't like something, we try to make the game more interesting and possibly make mistakes. Forgive us =([/i]

notes.title: Update 1.1.6.0 ( Terrifying - "Part 1" )
notes.content:
Hello, hunters! The first part of the big [b]"Terrifying"[/b] update is already waiting for you in the game!

So, what’s changed?

[h2]Light and darkness[/h2]

[i]Darkness thickens and almost covers you...[/i]

The lightning system has been reworked; now it’s pitch black inside the buildings.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/gi/Darkness1.gif[/img]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/gi/Darkness2.gif[/img]

And the light became softer and now has reflections.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/gi/With_GI1.gif[/img]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/gi/With_GI2.gif[/img]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/img/gi/With_GI3.gif[/img]

[u]We are still working on it, so there may be bugs, and it may still be inaccurate at times.[/u]

[h2]Get to know and study all of them![/h2]

[i]What danger does this creature present…[/i]

Now you all are newbies again, and you will have to collect information about all otherworldly entities all over again. Find evidence, then study it at the research table. You will receive information about the type of ghost or demon as well as about one of its features.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/research_table.gif[/img]

You or your teammates have to see the evidence with your own eyes to have the ability to write it down at the research table.

[i]Looks like this is...[/i]

We updated the features of ghosts and demons so you can better understand who you are facing and what kind of danger it poses through indirect evidence. But to get to know the features, you first have to study the particular entity at the research table.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/No_ghost_info.jpg[/img]

In each of the following parts of this update, we will add additional features to already existing ghosts and demons.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/ghost_lvl.png[/img]

You will have to increase your knowledge about any particular ghost or demon.

[h2]Even more dangerous[/h2]

The new difficulty is here! For those who like it [i]rough...[/i]

At the "Insane" difficulty, you and your friends will be left without the light…the power panel is broken.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/broke_shield.jpg[/img]

The darkness at that place is especially dangerous, and your sanity is at risk.



[i]The only thing that can help you are the lamps provided to us by the government. Here we call them “safety islands…”[/i]

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/lamp_insanya.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Place lamps throughout the house so that you can move from one to another without compromising your sanity. But be careful; there are only a limited number of lamps.

[*] Lamps can run out of power... The power indicator is located at the bottom of the lamp and consists of three levels. Recharge lamps by holding down the action key.

[*] Accept the challenge of an otherworldly entity and prove that you and your friends can deal with it even without the light!
[/list]

[h2]It is time for upgrades![/h2]

Now there's a “modules” section in the shop, which allows you to purchase upgrades for some equipment types as well as buy insurance!

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/modules.gif[/img]

Modules have a few levels, every one of which upgrades your equipment even further or increases the percentage of insurance.

[u]Modules are lost at death[/u]

[h2]But wait, there’s more...[/h2]

[list]
[*] The motion sensor’s light intensity is decreased

[*] Netcode was optimized (if you are still experiencing problems, contact us through Discord)

[*] Fixed some issues on certain maps

[*] A loading screen with tips was added

[*] Ghost events were partially updated

[*] Added a new tool, a “flashlight” (this is a different kind of flashlight, better than the standard one, but worse than the upgraded standard one)

[*] Night vision mode was updated

[*] The van was replaced with a car in homage to the hunter-brothers

[/list]

The first reworked ghost model was added to the game

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/girl_ghost.gif[/img]

notes.title: Latest news this year
notes.content:
Hello hunters! Happy New Year!

At the end of this year, we managed to do a lot, but we still have a lot of plans for next year.

[i]And we decided to share our plans for the next year with you, here is part of what we are going to implement
[/i]

[h2][b]Ghosts[/b][/h2] 
From the very release of the project into early access, we began to think about our own ghost models, and also, in addition to the usual models, on various details (but more on that later). At the moment we are working on sculpting models, but there is already something to show. This is the ghost of a girl, remember that this is not the final version, but only a prototype.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
Hello hunters, here’s an update!

In this update we added not so much content: it affects the technical aspects of the game — optimisation, bug fixes, game mechanics overhaul, balance.

But don’t be upset — all this is just a preparation for big changes in future updates

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

This was our main focus in this update. All this is a preparation for future updates with new content, vr-version, etc. Here’s a little description of what we’ve been up to:

[list]
[*] Added Light Culling — our own development, which allows to hide light sources where they are not visible to the player. It's still not perfect (blinking of light and its complete attenuation in some areas may be noticeable). We tried to minimize any visible imperfections as much as possible, but they can still be observed. We are working on it.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/lights.gif[/img]

[*] Added Mesh Culling — we have already experimented with this, but the previous version had various flaws. We found a new version and it’s better in all aspects.

[*] Added texture atlasing — as the visual appearance of the game is constantly overhauled, it will take some more time. We’re actively working on this.

[*] Character movement has been optimized. Now your movements will become smoother for your companions. Reduced the load on cpu and network.

[*] Reduced the load when ghost events appear. During a mass appearance some players might have short lags. We've worked on this, now it's less of a problem.

[*] Reduced load on RAM, we are trying to eliminate the extra load on RAM, in this update we tried to do it to the maximum.
[/list]

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

We’re very late with the tutorial content, so please forgive us.

In this update, we have prepared for you three training modes in the game and a practical part to consolidate everything you’ve learned!

[list]
[*] In the lobby appeared a board where you will find three sources of information about the game:

[olist]
[*] List of topics — a mode where you can choose the topic about the game you are interested in and read about it in detail.

[*] Video guides — short videos from youtube created by our friends - content creators. In the future, a whole series of training videos will be created. The list of videos will grow.

[*] Wikipedia — encyclopedia "Ghost Exile". Now it is still in development. We are working on translations and corrections of information. It will be available soon!
[/olist]

[*] The training order — it’s a practical part of the training touches upon some topics as working with tools, interacting with doors, the basics of hunting, identifying a ghost and its exiling. So that you have an incentive to keep on studying, after completing the training order you will receive a bonus in the form of a book with exiling rituals, a spray paint and $300!
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]

- Rooms cool down faster and heat up slower

- If the ritual of veneration is incorrect, the seal of banishment will break instead of death of the entire team

- Now there are two attempts to go through the world of shadows for each player, if the guard catches you the first time, he will kick you out of the world of shadows, next time he will kill you

- Now on the easy difficulty level you don’t die with the wrong ritual, but only lose part of your mind

- Now on medium difficulty level you don't die with a wrong ritual. Wrong ritual will cause the hunt

- Stamina recovers 20% faster

- Ghost movement speed while hunting depends on the difficulty level

- The time after which the ghost will lose sight of the player during the hunt now depends on the difficulty level

- The ghost's viewing angle now depends on the difficulty level

[h2]New[/h2]

[list]
[*] New updated lobby! The final version, which will only be complemented. Our idea with the development of our lobby still stands. The current lobby is the starting point for all hunters, earning money on orders, in the future you can open access to the cooler headquarters! And we're not just talking about appearance...

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/lobby.gif[/img]

[*] Overhaul of the video system — now you will see on the monitor what your companion sees with a camera in his hands. Some other camera-related bugs have also been fixed.

[*] Finally, the guy who buys paranormal pictures is back from vacation! Now you will receive a reward for each picture that captures things related to the otherworld, and if there are several such objects in one photo, the reward will significantly increase. The price depends on the rarity of the object in the photo.

A list of things that can be photographed and receive awards:
[list]
[*] Player corpse
[*] Ouija Board
[*] Bloody inscription
[*] Prints
[*] Traces on salt
[*] Favorite item
[*] Ghost
[*] Ghost Note
[*] Destroyed Seal
[*] Portal to the ghost world
[*] Portal to the world of shadows
[*] Pictures in notebook
[/list]

[*] The UI of the shop page has been changed to make it easier for you to buy tools.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/ui.png[/img]

[*] The tent has been replaced by containers to match the canon of the world where the events of the game take place, you will learn more in future updates.

There's much more space to fill with something new

[*] A new post-processing profile that adds more atmosphere, cinematography and improves the picture.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/pp.gif[/img]

If you are used to the old view of the game, just switch to the classic view in the settings
[/list]

[h2]Other fixes[/h2]

- Fixed a bug where a ghost could start hunting after the exile

- Fixed a bug where the hand and tool could go off the screen after sharp turn

- Now on locations you can turn on only 80% of all possible lighting. The electrical panel will turn off when overloaded

- Now the "Tab" key opens the lobby settings menu on the "lobby" location

- Fixed a bug where the portal to the world of shadows and dark portals could open in an inaccessible place

- Fixed a bug where the was no right door in the labyrinth of death

- Diary pages now have normal brightness, when player is dead

- Fixed a problem that caused a memory leak

[h2]Future update[/h2]
New content awaits you in a future update! The first big map - school with unique game mechanics, a completely redesigned hunter's diary, as well as a long-awaited character editor with new clothes, replacing the models of the people themselves with better ones, as well as small changes in the balance!
