notes.title: Ghost Exile update 1.0.9.0
notes.content:
Hello hunters! In this update, we have prepared a lot of innovations and fixes for you.

This update will open for you all the horrors of the otherworld, you will be able to plunge into the world of shadows controlled by a terrible entity, but we are sure you will be able to cope with it.

[h1]Updating the ritual[/h1]

We know that you are tired of the constant "close" and have added many innovations to the ritual that will not only diversify your gameplay, but also give you a deeper dive into the otherworld. The ritual is now divided into two phases.

The main part of the ritual remains the same, you still need to read the Holy Scriptures to get rid of the ghost. The second part will be the veneration of a part of the ghost's soul that has not yet been defiled by hatred.


[h3]The ritual has become more atmospheric[/h3]
[list]
[*] New sounds of the environment during the ritual
[*] The sound of blowing out candles
[*] Sound effects of seals
[*] Redesigned images of seals
[*] Increased the size of seals
[*] New Seal Rendering shader
[/list]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/pecat_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]

 [h3]A new event during the ritual[/h3]


During the ritual, at the difficulty levels "Experienced" and "Madman", there is a chance that a portal to the world of shadows will open.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/portal_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]

In the world of shadows, players need to spend a piece of the ghost's soul before the ritual seal.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/wisp_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]

Be careful, the souls imprisoned there who serve the ancient dark essence wander through the world of shadows. Shadows immediately inform their mistress of your location if you get too close to them.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/shadows_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/granny_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]

[h3]Updating portal mechanics[/h3]

Closing portals has become more interactive now you need to approach the portal and say "close" only once, then the portal will connect with you and over time will begin to decrease.

During the closing of the portal, an event may begin, be careful!

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/portal_lil_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]

[b]Be careful, after the portal contacts you, you cannot leave it until it closes![/b]

[h3]Honoring a piece of the soul[/h3]

A new mandatory part of the ritual was the veneration of a piece of the ghost's good soul.

When a message appears in the ritual book about the need to honor the deceased, players need to find a room in the house suitable for the ritual of veneration. The directional microphone, which has been completely redesigned in this update, will help you with this.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/sen_on11.0.9.0.gif[/img]

With the help of a directional microphone, players need to find a sound source that emits a bright part of the soul. Follow the sound power scale to determine the direction. If you are close enough to the source, a mark with the exact location will appear on the scanner field.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/soundsens_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]

After finding the right room, you must draw a special seal for the ritual of worship and place a bowl of incense on it. Only then will you be able to continue the banishment ritual.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/chasha_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]

[h3]New seals[/h3]

The game has two new seals that will help you during the hunt.

[list]
[*] The Ashukut seal is a seal that is used during the ritual to honor a good part of the soul.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Ashukut_seal.png[/img]

[*] The Dzhar'uerak seal is a trap seal, if it gets into it, the ghost will get stuck in it for a while.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/Jar_seal.png[/img]

[/list]

[h3]Directional microphone[/h3]

The mechanics of the directional microphone have been completely redesigned. Now it is an obligatory part of the ritual and serves as a tool for finding a room of worship. The display has become more informative, it has a radial field where the sound source is marked, which emits a piece of the soul and a scale of sound power.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/sensordot_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]

[h3]The Labyrinth of Death[/h3]

Now the ghost will not leave you even after your death, he will test you in the labyrinth of death. Players need to go through the maze and find the right door to be able to help their still-alive companions.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/correct_door.gif[/img]

Terrifying corridors where a ghost will follow you on your heels and arrange all sorts of traps for you and confusing you with false doors.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/trap_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]

If the ghost overtakes you, it will begin to absorb the remnants of your soul. Fight it, but keep in mind you can only fight back against the ghost three times then it will devour you!

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/otsos_1.0.9.0.gif[/img]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/wrong_door.gif[/img]
After a successful escape, you will return to the house where you died and will be able to help your friends expel the otherworldly entity. This will help you with the abilities that you will acquire after death:

[list]
[*] Knocking is the ability to make a knocking sound anywhere in the house. Help your friends find the way by sound!
[*] Throwing objects - You can throw some objects in the house. Pay attention to yourself or scare your friends when they least expect it!
[*] EMF field - the ability to create a strong EMF field anywhere in the house that can slow down a ghost while hunting. Help your comrades not to share your fate!
[/list]

You will also receive an additional percentage of insurance if you get out of the maze of death.

[h3]Remakes of old maps[/h3]

Tremont now it is not the only map that has undergone changes both visual and structural.

[b]House on Woodward Ave.[/b]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/woodward1.png[/img]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/woodward2.png[/img]
[b]House on Southwest Blvd.[/b]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/south1.png[/img]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/south2.png[/img]

[h3]New items[/h3]

Three new items will now help you determine the type of ghost and expel it.

Incense bowl

It is necessary for the phase of the ritual with the veneration of a good part of the soul. It also serves to restore sanity - install the bowl anywhere in the house and light it with a lighter, this will restore some of the sanity to everyone who is in range.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/use_chace.gif[/img]

Wall thermometer

Tired of walking around the rooms in search of a negative temperature? Install a wall thermometer on the wall in any room and you can look for other clues. The device will inform you with an audible signal that a negative temperature has been noticed in the room.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/termo.gif[/img]

Seal Eraser

If you have installed the wrong seal or in the wrong place, use the seal eraser and you can apply a new one!

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/stirat.gif[/img]

[h3]Updating labels[/h3]

Now consumable items such as spray paint, salt, pills, etc. have a creator. "Ghost company" is developing equipment for ghost hunting, let's thank them for it!

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/eticet.png[/img]

[h3]Dynamic environment[/h3]

At the moment we are working on a new mechanic that will add atmosphere to your gaming sessions. On some maps there are variations of the environment that will give you the opportunity to imagine what was happening in this house before you came.

[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/variation2.png[/img]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/variation1.png[/img]

[h2]Other[/h2]

- Fixed a bug where steam from the mouth appeared even if there was a positive temperature in the room

- Fixed a bug with the desynchronization of indicators on the activity monitor

- Now the incense and crosses used will not be taken into account during the ritual with the condition

- Fixed a bug where a haze and a light remained after the ghost was expelled

- Added a confirmation window when pressing the exit button during the match

- Slowing down the player's movement on the stairs now depends on the difficulty level 40, 50, 60%

- Increased running duration by 10%

- All items that were available from level 3 are now available from level 2

- Reduced the volume of the car alarm

- The interval between hunts now depends on the difficulty level of 15-30, 12-20, 8-17 seconds

- Now the ghost has a reduced chance to hear your footsteps if you are not running or are in a squat

- Fixed a bug where the brightness on the contrary decreased after the expulsion of the ghost

[h3]Future plans[/h3]

[b]In future updates, you will get to know the cursed school.[/b]

Few managed to get out of there alive. School corridors are blocked or blocked, doors are barricaded or closed, you and your friends will have to find another way to fully explore this hellish place.

[b]The dressing room will open soon![/b]

You will finally be able to transform your character by making it unique and memorable.

[b]What happens if you lose your diary?[/b]

It will be very unpleasant because there is a lot of information collected by you over the years. It's good that you keep the diary of your old friend and partner.

notes.title: Ghost Exile update 1.0.8.2
notes.content:
[h1]Favourite Things[/h1]
In this update, we are pleased to introduce you to several important changes and innovations that set a new vector for the development of our game.

[h2]Drawers / Lockers with things[/h2]
As you know, we had some problems with the passport in the drawers, we completely reworked the system and also added a nice innovation, these are various things that lie as a decoration, which will add some aesthetic dynamics in the search for various items.

[h2]GamePlus[/h2]
This is a system that will allow you to customize the match to your liking, remove unnecessary content in your opinion, in the future it will allow us to add new content without risking spoiling the impression of the game to people who are used to playing without it.

[h2]GamePlus - Favourite Things[/h2]
This is the debut content for the GamePlus system, you can disable it in the match settings in the “Additional content” section, its essence is that now a furnace will appear in the car in which you need to burn the ghost's favorite thing to weaken it before the ritual. It will not be easy to find a thing, in addition to favorite thing, false things will appear on the shelves, in cabinets, in drawers that you may mistake for favorite thing. The ghost, after 8 minutes of the start of the match, if there is a player next to the thing, begins to get angry, which can serve as a ghost error, because you will immediately understand what kind of thing is in question. In addition, the ghost after 8/13 minutes will throw under one note, after reading it you will be able to roughly understand what kind of thing it is about. After you decide what kind of thing it is, you have only 3 attempts to burn the right one. If you can't destroy your favorite thing, then it will be almost impossible to carry out the ritual. Also, after the destruction of a favorite thing, the ghost will turn on a special rage mode until the end of the match (before expulsion), a special mode is set randomly at the beginning of the match.

[h3]Behaviours after destroy favourite thing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nothing ( ghost can't do anything , 3% chance)
[*] Aggressiveness ( the ghost will almost always be too aggressive and active )
[*] Mind Destroyer ( a ghost with violent power will drain your mind , this makes you more vulnerable to attacks )
[*] Killer ( every 60 seconds with a chance (3%, 7%, 9%) can launch an attack )
[*] Ritual Killer ( every 45 seconds with a chance (5%, 9%, 12%) can launch an attack during the ritual )
[*] Portal creator ( every 40 seconds with a chance ( 8%, 12%, 15%) it can create a portal in any room of the house, such a portal does not have a clue (the road to the portal), has a raised sound, expands more slowly, and it is easier to close it than the portal during the ritual)
[/list]

[h2]GamePlus - Additional conditions[/h2]
To complicate the rituals, we have added content to Game Plus that will add +1 conditions for rituals, the condition is set at the beginning of the match randomly.

[h2]Game Plus - AI improvements[/h2]
The ghost becomes more difficult, the ghost hears you without pressing the voice key, has a better memory, and fine hearing.

[h2]Temperatures[/h2]
Now the ghost affects the temperature in the room, being in it, it cools the room to low temperatures,
Players being in the room also affect the temperature of the room by heating it (the more players the higher the temperature).

[h2]Thermometer[/h2]
Now it has 3 charges for measuring the temperature in the rooms, when you click (according to the standard left mouse button)
, the temperature measurement process begins, after the beeps the final result will be displayed.


[h2]Remake map - House on Tremont Street.[/h2]
We decided to try out new graphics for our homes and decided to start by recreating the smallest map at the moment.
We have slightly increased its size and added a basement.
We also redesigned the tent a little, made it more neat.

[u]The rest of the minor changes we will write in the usual list:[/u]

[h1]News from development[/h1]
Hello again, hunters! Our development team is here with some news. 

[h2]Pills[/h2]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/pills.gif[/img]
If your sanity score drops too low, your life is in danger! Each second, the threat is growing stronger. To regain your sanity, take a pill. However, this is not a panacea – pills make up only 30% of your lost energy, so use them wisely.

[h2]Tripod[/h2]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/shtativ.gif[/img]
Sometimes it is just impossible to put the camera in the right place. The surface may not be unsuitable or there is not enough space. In this case, use a tripod to fix the camera in any convenient position.

[h2]Spotlight[/h2]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/spotlight.gif[/img]
A flashlight or a lantern is good, but it has limitations. It is not bright enough and does not reach far. In this case a spotlight comes to the rescue: it is several times more effective than the flashlight. It also has some disadvantages: it is not mobile and can only be recharged in the tent. Use it wisely, for it can save your life.

notes.title: News from development
notes.content:
[h1]News from development[/h1]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/title.gif[/img]
[b]Hi Hunters![/b] For the last week we have been focusing on intensive development and have not been able to properly pay attention to the news or dev blog. Today we have allocated a little time and we want to tell you about some of the tools in the game. Let's say right away that we won't talk about all of them because we want players to enter the game themselves and see everything with their own eyes.

[h2][b]Motion Sensor[/b][/h2]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/MoveSensor.gif[/img]
A device with which you can determine the movement of a ghost across the location. It also reacts to ghosts of players and alive players. In addition it has a second mode (infra-red): it aims to find out the type of ghost since it serves as evidence for certain ghosts.

[h2][b]Zone EMF sensor[/b][/h2]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/emf_radar.gif[/img]
This tool will help you to identify the source of EMF at long distances but it only indicates the direction of the source, not the signal strength. This will help players determine the direction where the ghost is interacting with anything on large maps. 

[h2][b]Voice recorder[/b][/h2]
[img]https://ghost-exile.site/steam-files/recorder.gif[/img]
This device is used to record the environment: you need to speak into the recorder to interact with the ghost. Then, while listening to the tape, you can hear the ghost on the tape trying to tell you something. Further this can be considered as evidence in determining the type of ghost.
